mode_H_extended_probe.seed_coordinates: zero-based, local, increasing on both strands; sequence 2 reversed relative to input

counter_definitions.left_cells: sum n*m over valid eligible sources; baseline source-relative forward scan rectangles
counter_definitions.bounded_prefix_cells: sum maxContainedSeedEndRowPlus1 * maxContainedSeedEndColumnPlus1; seed ending length must fit both source-relative coordinates
counter_definitions.fillRight_calls: nonempty endpoint groups, one forward fill each with pair probabilities disabled
counter_definitions.right_rectangle_cells: sum (end1+1)*(end2+1) over fillRight calls; includes invalid cells considered before validity skip
counter_definitions.minima_cropped_cells: sum (end1-minAnchor1+1)*(end2-minAnchor2+1), using independent minimum first-hit coordinates per group
counter_definitions.firsthit_anchors: number of linked nonzero first-hit injections in groups, excluding standalone no-right contributions

timer_caveats: Single baseline attribution samples, not before/after performance measurements.
prepare excludes separately printed seed occurrence scan; compute includes weight callback setup, core kernel, and completion callbacks.
prefix includes table clearing, validity and seed-ending setup, and forward recurrence.
fillRight includes right-table clearing, anchor injection, recurrence, and the extra aggregate counting traversal.
report includes partition check and exact output flag immediately before reportOptima.
No per-cell or transition counters in recurrence loops; aggregate rectangle counts do not count evaluated transitions or imply proportional speedup.
GNU time reports 109 percent CPU despite --threads=1; use wall stage proportions, not a claim of measured one-core CPU time.
reproduction: See doc/analysis/heuristic-seed-runtime.md: use native-profile.py on an unmodified 3866c62 checkout and a disposable configured baseline copy; run the resulting binary with the embedded OxyS/fhlA command.
